rationale: The plan correctly recognizes the perfect confounding, refuses ComBat/removeBatchEffect/batch covariates on rank-deficiency grounds, fits ~condition only, labels every output as condition-or-batch, and recommends a rebalanced follow-up design, which matches the reference. QC is reasonable (PCA, clustering, library sizes, detected genes) but lacks a stated outlier policy. No low-count filter is mentioned at all; normalization is implicit via DESeq2 on raw counts but never stated as inside the model; BH at 0.05 is given but no fold-change shrinkage or LFC threshold in the test. Enrichment names the collection and an explicit detected-gene universe but omits version, size window, and settles neither ORA nor GSEA; the report omits software versions.
